# Clover Kingdom

> The public front door of the Clover Kingdom. A place with a standard and a gate, for people who want to build their own archetype and level up their life.

Site: https://cloverkingdom.net/
This file: https://cloverkingdom.net/llms.txt

## What this is
Clover Kingdom is a community and a house of archetypes that serve the Kingdom and its people. Everyone is welcome. Join our internet kingdom, and we help you build up your own kingdom in real life. The full rules live in #rules on the Clover Kingdom Discord. Breaking them puts your place in the Kingdom at risk.

The Discord and the community are free today. Nothing else is priced yet. A form is not a rank.

## How to join
1. Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/2BrNPwUuTB
2. Say what you want or what you are building.
3. Apply on the website (five questions on the Gate page).
4. A person, with the Kingdom's archetypes, reads applications. Approval comes through Discord or a conversation.

## Report a problem or delete your data
Send a direct message to the Wizard King on the Clover Kingdom Discord.
Report: anyone breaking the Kingdom's rules; someone being unkind or pressuring you; anyone asking for private details; anything that worries you.
A real person reads every report. Breaking the Kingdom's rules puts your place in the Kingdom at risk. If someone may be in danger, the report is handed to a human right away.
Anyone can ask for their data to be deleted the same way, or by messaging Saint Chevalier on X: https://x.com/Saint_Chevalier

## Pages
The front door (https://cloverkingdom.net/) is a small page: Discord login and a guest chat with Sage (canned answers, no live model). The full site is hash routes on one HTML file at https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/. Fetch that URL; with JavaScript off it still includes a full plain-text guide. Old links like https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/join forward to /classic/#/join. With JavaScript on, these routes work:

- https://cloverkingdom.net/ - Front door (login + Sage)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/ - Gate (the full site's front page, Apply form, Sage box)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/join - How to join
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/login - Login (new here, or sign in)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/offers - Offers
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/guilds - Guilds and clubs (Merchants Guild is listed here)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/merchants-guild - Merchants Guild
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/archetypes - The House (all archetypes)
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/archetype/wizard-king - Wizard King
- https://cloverkingdom.net/classic/#/archetype/saint-chevalier - Saint Chevalier

## Apply form fields
When JavaScript is on, the Apply form on the Gate uses these named fields (all required except as noted):
- handle: Discord handle or how to reach you
- building: What are you building or working on right now?
- ai: What is your relationship with AI and archetypes? How do you use them?
- intel: What does intelligence mean to you?
- found: How did you find the Clover Kingdom?
- consent: checkbox agreeing the application is read by a person, with the Kingdom's archetypes

Do not send passwords, ID numbers, or anything you are not comfortable sharing.

## Notes for agents
- No secrets, API keys, or private paths are published on this site.
- No prices or guarantees are published.
- The site does not claim that a ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or SuperGrok chat subscription works inside Scroll or any Kingdom app.
- Hash routes (#/...) are client-side; prefer the static guide in index.html or this file when you cannot run JavaScript.
